# namesilo_dnssec_records (Data Source)

Reads one domain's DS records as NameSilo currently publishes them. Use it to audit a DNSSEC delegation managed outside Terraform, or to compare against the `namesilo_dnssec_records` resource's desired set in a plan.

The records are normalized the same way the resource stores them: digests lowercased, so a set comparison against configured records does not diff on case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "namesilo_dnssec_records" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "ds_records" {
  value = data.namesilo_dnssec_records.example.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain whose DS records to read, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name. It is inert and makes `tofu state show` readable.
- `records` (Attributes Set) The domain's DS records. An unsigned domain yields an empty set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) The DNSSEC signing algorithm number of the zone's DNSKEY, e.g. 8 (RSA/SHA-256) or 13 (ECDSA P-256/SHA-256).
- `digest` (String) The hexadecimal digest of the zone's DNSKEY, lowercased.
- `digest_type` (Number) The digest algorithm that produced `digest`, e.g. 2 (SHA-256).
- `key_tag` (Number) The key tag: the RFC 4034 identifier of the zone's DNSKEY that this DS record points at.
